user_query: I'm a football enthusiast and I want to keep track of the televised matches in Peru. Can you provide me with the list of teams and competitions that will be broadcasted? Also, I'm interested in knowing the dates, channels, and images of the upcoming events. It would be really helpful for my football schedule.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of football teams participating in competitions in Peru.
Retrieve a list of football competitions currently happening in Peru.
Get the broadcast schedule for the upcoming matches, including dates, channels, and match details.
Gather images and promotional material for the upcoming events.
